settings.label: Pi subagents
settings.description: Enable the built-in Pi child-session subagents (`spawn_subagent`, native Tasks/child views). Default on; takes effect for new grok-pi sessions.

settings.label: Pi subagents V2
settings.description: Enable optional Subagents V2 team tools (spawn_team, stable /root/... agent paths, peer messaging, nested spawn) on top of Pi subagents. Requires Pi subagents; takes effect for new grok-pi sessions.
